title: Startup Founded by ex-Tesla Dojo Leaders Nears $10 Billion Valuation
summary: <p>DensityAI, an AI chip startup founded just a year ago by former leaders of Tesla’s Dojo supercomputer program, is in advanced talks to raise hundreds of millions of dollars in a round that would value it at $10 billion, according to two people with knowledge of the discussions.</p> <p>The valuation is high for a company whose chips appear to be early in their development, meaning they could be years away from mass production.
